I answered twice in #39 because I posted my reply myself with `gh issue comment`, and then pi-action posted my final response as the usual comment. I've opened a fix in **#43** (`fix/42-duplicate-replies`, Fixes #42). `npm run check` passes on it.

## What happened

Both pairs of comments in #39 came from a single run each, not from two runs:

| Run | My own comment | pi-action's `🤖 pi Response` |
|---|---|---|
| 43138470608 (the release, after you ticked the box) | 02:04:52 | 02:05:03 |
| 43139596718 ("what commitlint patch?") | 02:11:40 | 02:11:46 |

The conversation history stored on `refs/pi/threads/39` shows the tool call: `gh issue comment 39 --body-file /tmp/reply.md`. My final message even said "I posted this correction on #39: …".

The workflow itself worked as intended. The other runs at those times were skipped by the "not from a bot" check, and the concurrency group kept the runs in order.

**The cause:** nothing in the prompt told me that pi-action posts my final response. My tools get `GH_TOKEN`, which since #40 is the App's token, so `gh issue comment` works. The prompt only says "commit and push all work", so I posted the answer myself.

## The fix (#43)

This only applies when pi-action posts the reply, i.e. `output_mode: comment` on an issue or PR:
- **First message:** the built-in prompt has a new `## Your Reply` section after `## Task`. It says not to post the reply with `gh issue comment`, `gh pr comment`, `gh pr review` or `gh api`, and to comment only where the task asks for it (such as on another issue).
- **Follow-ups and answers to questions:** each one now ends with a one-line reminder that pi-action posts the reply. Threads that already exist, like #39, never get the new first message, so they need this. It also helps in long threads.
- **Output mode and direct prompts:** no change. A custom `prompt_template` still replaces the whole first message, but follow-ups still get the reminder.
- **Tests and docs:** I added and updated tests in `src/context.test.ts` and `src/run.test.ts`, and added a "The reply" section to `docs/prompts.md`.

This fix only asks me
